# PinkSurfing

> PinkSurfing is a social business hub with three products: App (messaging + PayChat), Shop (multi-vendor marketplace), and Vendors (seller dashboard). Payments are powered by Square. Receiving PayChat and vendor payouts are United States only.

## Products

- App: https://app.pinksurfing.com — Chat, voice/video, stories, PayChat (pay-per-message; the person who got paid can send unlimited messages), contracts, wallet. Android on Google Play; iOS coming soon.
- Shop: https://shop.pinksurfing.com — Products, businesses for sale, real estate, vehicles, electronics, GigHub hiring.
- Vendors: https://vendors.pinksurfing.com — Vendor login and storefront management. US-only payouts.
